title: Duality of the noise operator's hypercontractive bound
statement:
Let $p$ and $p'$ be Hölder conjugate exponents, so that $1/p + 1/p' = 1$, and suppose $1 \le p$. Write $T_{\sqrt{p-1}}$ for the noise operator with rate $\rho = \sqrt{p-1}$ acting on Boolean functions of a single bit. Suppose that
\[
  \E\!\left[\,\bigl|T_{\sqrt{p-1}} f\bigr|^{2}\,\right]^{1/2} \;\le\; \E\!\left[\,|f|^{p}\,\right]^{1/p}
\]
holds for every one-bit Boolean function $f$. Then for every one-bit Boolean function $g$,
\[
  \E\!\left[\,\bigl|T_{\sqrt{p-1}} g\bigr|^{p'}\,\right]^{1/p'} \;\le\; \E\!\left[\,|g|^{2}\,\right]^{1/2}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: the $(p \to 2)$ bound $\E[|T_{\sqrt{p-1}}f|^2]^{1/2} \le \E[|f|^p]^{1/p}$ holds for every one-bit Boolean function $f$
conclusion holds for every one-bit Boolean function $g$
replaced:
If, for H\"older conjugate exponents $p$ and $p'$ with $1 \le p$, the noise operator with rate
$\sqrt{p-1}$ satisfies the $(p,2)$-hypercontractive bound for every one-bit function, then it also
satisfies the dual $(2,p')$-hypercontractive bound: for every $g$,
\[
  \big(\E[|T_{\sqrt{p-1}} g|^{p'}]\big)^{1/p'} \le \big(\E[g^2]\big)^{1/2}.
\]
